newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish KPW to mull NFI trade approval on April 2-3.
newsitem.headline: Polish KPW to mull NFI trade approval on April 2-3.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) will consider clearing for public trade National Investment Funds (NFIs) in the country's mass privatisation scheme on April 2-3, the KPW said in a statement.
Under the government's NFI programme, shares in about 500 mid-sized companies are allocated to 15 NFIs run by foreign and domestic management firms.
The 26 million Poles who bought a participation unit in the scheme will have the opportunity to exchange it for 15 shares, one in each fund, which are expected to start bourse trade around mid-year.
